messages:
maria: Quick sync  we need to finalize social for the webinar on serving economics. Deliverables: X thread (4 tweets), LinkedIn carousel (3 cards), hero image (1200x627), 15s promo clip, GIF for community. Also confirm UTM scheme and SDR routing. Can we lock creative by Wed 10am?
josh: Pasting rough thread copy (feel free to edit):
1) "Serving LLMs isn't a model problem, it's an ops problem. We're sharing battle-tested tactics. Register -> https://redwood.ai/webinar/serving-launch"
2) "We ran cost/latency tests across 3 clusters. Results = practical levers you can apply.
3) "Live demo + Q&A with infra folks. Free lunch for early questions.
4) "Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar/serving-launch #mlops #llmops"
kevin: Let's A/B the leading hook on X: Variant A = "Reduce inference cost 3x" Variant B = "Same latency, half the cost". Audience split: A = startups, B = enterprise. Also propose boosting post B for enterprise audience on LinkedIn.
priya: For UTMs, i'll standardize: utm_campaign=serving_launch_v2, then add utm_term=startup or enterprise. Also create separate landing anchors so we can pipeline users into different nurture flows.
sam (SDR): Routing: HubSpot list = webinar_serving_launch. Use workflow to create contact + assign owner via round-robin. Spike rule: if job title contains "VP" or "Director" then mark high-intent and notify kevin@redwood.ai + create a 'high-intent' task.
maria: Nice. For CTAs choose between "Save your seat" and "Register now". Which converts better historically?\e pr iya: Historically "Register now" gets higher CTR; "Save your seat" slightly higher conversion on LinkedIn. We'll test both across platforms.
josh: Asset asks for design: hero PNG (1200x627), carousel slides (1080x1080), short clip script (3 lines), GIF (loop). Can design confirm they can deliver by Wed 9am? @design-bot?
design-bot: Designer assigned: @leo. ETA: Wed 8:30am PST for initial comps. Will post Figma link in this thread when ready.
priya: I'll also wire a Zapier zap: on form submission create HubSpot contact, add to list "webinar_serving_launch", set property utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, and trigger welcome email + Slack notification to #sales-inbound.
kevin: Paid variant: if we promote on LinkedIn, append utm_paid=1 and use 30s video. Priya please draft budget and audiences.
sam (SDR): Follow-up templates (suggested):
- Immediate auto-email: "Thanks for registering! Here's your calendar invite + resources. Interested in a quick call to discuss your infra?"
- High-value lead (title match / company >200 employees): "Thanks for joining - we'd love to learn about your infra plans. Book 20 min -> calendly link"
- No-show nurture: "Sorry we missed you. Recording + key takeaways here. Want a quick walkthrough?"
kevin: Also build a retargeting list of registrants who didn't sign up for product trial. We'll export to ad platform after -7 days.
maria: Scheduling: Buffer queue proposed dates: Apr 9 (announce) Apr 11 (reminder) Apr 15 (last call). Buffer saved drafts need final copy + images.
buffer-bot: Drafts created in Buffer for Apr 9 09:00, Apr 11 09:00, Apr 15 08:00 PST. Approval needed by Apr 8 17:00 PST.
josh: Small edit to X thread opener to be punchier: "Reduce LLM inference cost without sacrificing latency. We're showing how. Thread ->"
priya: I'll create landing variants: /webinar/serving-launch?variant=startup and ?variant=enterprise so we can route into different HubSpot workflows. Sam confirm you can pick up both.
sam (SDR): Confirmed. Also set a follow-up SLA: first outreach within 24 hours of registration for high-intent, 72 hours for general.
maria: Approval checklist: josh final thread copy Tue 4pm, design deliverables Wed 9am, priya HubSpot + UTMs Wed 10am, kevin paid audience + budget Wed noon, sam SDR templates Wed 11am. Ping when done.
kevin: One more ask  can we include a short quote in LinkedIn carousel from an early customer who saw cost improvements? Josh / Customer ops can surface.
josh: I'll pull a quote and add to slide 2.
maria: Thanks everyone  once assets are up i'll schedule the Buffer posts and well A/B as planned.
